zh: 环（ring）：签名时给定的一组公钥集合，其中恰有签名者持有的一把对应私钥；本语料未登记任何环签名论文，此定义按留存件可支撑的范围给出。
验证对象的改变：从一把公钥对应一次签名，改为一组公钥中某一把对应；fips186-5.txt:36 是被改变的模型本身。
签名者歧义：验证结果只说明集合内某成员签名，不指明是谁；这是用身份结论换来的性质。
放弃不可否认性：fips186-5.txt:23 把普通签名的证据性目标写作 non-repudiation，不指明签署者即无法拘束签署者。
逐消息秘密值 k：fips186-5.txt:627 要求每次签名生成都产生，debian-dsa1571.html:93-94 说明它一旦被预测便泄露私钥。
算法可协商点：rfc4252.txt:474-476 允许在认证中提出任意公钥算法，是外部方案唯一的接入位置。
en: ring: the set of public keys a signature is verified against, containing the signer's own; no ring-signature paper is registered in this corpus, so the definition is stated only as far as the retained texts support it.
change of verification object: from one public key per signature to one of a set - fips186-5.txt:36 is the model being changed, not the change itself.
signer ambiguity: the verification result says a member signed and not who; that is the property bought with the identity conclusion.
non-repudiation: the evidentiary goal FIPS 186-5 states at fips186-5.txt:23, deliberately given up, since a signature naming no signer binds no signer.
per-message secret k: required at each signature generation (fips186-5.txt:627); debian-dsa1571.html:93-94 shows a guessable one compromises signing keys.
algorithm negotiation point: rfc4252.txt:474-476 lets any public key algorithm be offered in authentication - the only registered place an outside scheme can appear.
